skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and describe basic concepts related to information and information systems, components, functions, and roles in organizations and businesses.
Understand and identify the position and function of technology used in information systems.
Understand and classify information systems from a management and decision-making perspective.
Understand and classify information systems applied in business.
Understand and explain the process of developing information systems in organizations and businesses.
Understand and describe issues related to managing information system resources and security.
Communicate effectively in writing and on the internet for professional tasks related to management information systems.
Use software to solve management and business administration problems.
Have skills in systematic thinking and modeling in approaching and solving problems.
Be able to work independently or participate in teams related to information systems management.
Have appropriate attitudes and behaviors related to safety and social ethical standards in the field of information systems management.
Use Microsoft Excel for data analysis and problem-solving.
